turns.utterance: Please complete the following checks: First, inspect the belt surface for cuts, gouges, or embedded debris. Second, check the splice joint for separation or edge lifting. Third, inspect both pulley faces for grooving or material buildup.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the belt surface for cuts, gouges, or embedded debris. 2. Check the splice joint for separation or edge lifting. 3. Inspect both pulley faces for grooving or material buildup.

turns.utterance: visual inspection complete belt surface looks good no signifcant cuts or debris. splice joint intact and both pulley faces are clean

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the belt surface for cuts, gouges, or embedded debris. 2. Check the splice joint for separation or edge lifting. 3. Inspect both pulley faces for grooving or material buildup.

turns.utterance: Based on your belt damage assessment, do you see splice failure or deep cuts?

turns.utterance: no belt is in good condition no splice failure or deep cuts observed

turns.utterance: Is the belt tracking within plus or minus 5 millimetres of centreline?

turns.utterance: belt tracking looks good now running within tolerance

turns.utterance: Is the belt tension within the specified deflection range?

turns.utterance: ok so deflection measurement is outside the allowable range belt tension needs adjustmnet

ground_truth.node_text: Belt tension within specified deflection range?

turns.utterance: Adjust the take up tensioner to correct the belt deflection.

turns.utterance: take up tensioner adjusted corrected the belt deflection

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust take up tensioner to correct belt deflection

turns.utterance: Reverify belt tension after the take up adjustment.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: belt tension now within spec deflection is in the correct range

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify belt tension after take up adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do all idler rollers rotate freely with no flat spots?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: yeah all idler rollers rotating smoothly no binding flat spots or surface damage detected

ground_truth.node_text: All idler rollers rotate freely with no flat spots?

turns.utterance: Is the drive motor temperature within the rated limit?

turns.utterance: motor temp is acceptable both end cap readings are below the nameplate maximum

ground_truth.node_text: Drive motor temperature within rated limit?

turns.utterance: Is the drive chain elongation within the wear limit?

turns.utterance: looks like the chain has streched beyond the acceptable wear limit elongation exceeds spec

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Replace the drive chain and retension to specification.

turns.utterance: drive chain replaced and retensioned to spec

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Jog the conveyor slowly until a reference part reaches the end of line sensor. Observe the sensor indicator light and measure the distance from the part leading edge to the sensor face at the trigger point. Compare against the setpoint distance on the sensor setup drawing.

ground_truth.node_text: Jog the conveyor slowly until a reference part reaches the end of line sensor and observe the sensor indicator light. Measure the distance from the part leading edge to the sensor face at the trigger point using a steel rule. Compare against the setpoint distance specified on the sensor setup drawing and adjust the bracket position if the trigger point is outside tolerance.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: sensor trigger point measured recorded the distance and compared it to the setup drawing

ground_truth.node_text: Jog the conveyor slowly until a reference part reaches the end of line sensor and observe the sensor indicator light. turns.utterance: Is the end of line sensor trigger point within plus or minus 2 millimetre tolerance?

turns.utterance: trigger point is outside tolerance its off by more than 2mm

turns.utterance: Reposition the sensor bracket and reteach the trigger point.
